data.name: Bobseine
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Bobseine is the name of a river goddess. She was said to protect and nurture those who lived near her waters. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'bous,' meaning ox, and 'seine,' meaning goddess of the river.
